038package dev.visdb.seesaw.models;
039
040import ca.odell.glazedlists.EventList;
041
042/**
043 * This class adds support for GlazedLists EventList and locking,
044 * see {@link KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.Remodel}.
045 * @param <K> key type; key is typically primary key
046 * @param <D> displayValue type; displayValue provides display string
047 * @param <D2>  d2 type; if present, extra data
048 *
049 * @see <a href="https://javadoc.io/doc/com.glazedlists/glazedlists/latest/ca/odell/glazedlists/swing/AutoCompleteSupport.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GlazedLists AutoCompletion javadoc</a>
050 * @see <a href="https://publicobject.com/glazedlistsdeveloper/screencasts/autocompletesupport/AutoCompleteSupport.wmv" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">GlazedLists AutoCompletion Video</a>
051 *
052 * @since 4.0.0
053 */
054public class GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo<K, D, D2> extends KeyDisplayValueSwingModel<K, D, D2> {
055  private final EventList<ListItem> eventList;
056  private boolean hasReturnedEventList;
057
058  /**
059   * Create an empty ComboInfo.
060   * @param d2Flag true says to provide an options2 field in ListItem
061   * @param eventList which is installed into AutoCompleteSupport
062   */
063  public GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo(HasD2 d2Flag, EventList<ListItem> eventList) {
064    super(d2Flag, eventList);
065    this.eventList = eventList;
066  }
067
068  /**
069   * This dance only returns the event list once; it helps make it
070   * clear that no reference should be held to the list. All access
071   * to the list should be done through this object and remodel.
072   * There is {@link AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel#getItemList}
073   * for a read only reference.
074   * @return GlazedLists event list.
075   */
076  protected EventList<ListItem> getEventList() {
077    EventList<ListItem> temp = hasReturnedEventList ? null : eventList;
078    hasReturnedEventList = true;
079    return temp;
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * The Remodel is the core object to support locked access to this object.
084   * It has methods for inspecting and changing the EventList and
085   * the contents of the SSListItems that it contains.
086   * <p>
087   * This getRemodel object can be used with try with resources.
088   * It returns with the EventList write locked, and its close method
089   * releases the lock.
090   * @return a Remodel with read/write access
091   */
092  @Override
093  public Remodel getRemodel() {
094    return new Remodel();
095  }
096
097  /**
098   * This is called during Remodel construction,
099   * take the EventList's write lock.
100   * @param remodel
101   */
102  @Override
103  protected void remodelTakeWriteLock(AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel remodel) {
104    eventList.getReadWriteLock().writeLock().lock();
105    super.remodelTakeWriteLock(remodel); // after taking the lock
106  }
107
108  /**
109   * This is called during Remodel close,
110   * release the EventList's write lock.
111   * NOTE: {@code remodel.isClosed = true} prevents re-use of the remodel.
112   * @param remodel base remodel
113   */
114  @Override
115  protected void remodelReleaseWriteLock(AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel remodel) {
116    super.remodelReleaseWriteLock(remodel); // before releasing the lock
117    eventList.getReadWriteLock().writeLock().unlock();
118  }
119}
